body.x: Dongnam Realize Inc. (CEO Linda Hyun) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

Dongnam Realize is a company that produces CXP wood, a wood material that can be processed through thermoplastic molding, such as injection and extrusion. They seek to create a culture of using wood and allowing all members involved in production and consumption to easily participate in making the forest beneficial through CXP wood.

CXP wood is a material that can be used in existing plastic factories and can replace most plastic products in our everyday lives with wood products. The by-products that are naturally produced in forestry and agriculture processes are processed and distributed in a form that can be melted in a factory. Dongnam Realize explained that this reduces the amount of waste produced in the forestry industry and is largely helpful in reducing the absolute amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere by sequestering them into products.

The flame-retardant CXP wood power strip they will introduce at the trade show has flame-retardant properties despite being made of wood. It is a user and environmentally friendly product that is non-toxic, not just in regular high-temperature flame-retardant tests, but also in low-temperature fires that can occur in homes.

A spokesman for Dongnam Realize said that, “We wanted to change the stereotypes people have about wood, of being weak to fires and being difficult to use. After launching CXP materials for the first time last year in August, we were able to accomplish achievements like entering over 100 zero waste shops (eco-friendly stores) and reaching sales totaling 1 billion KRW in just 1 year in 2022,” and said that, “We are researching applications with large companies in Korea and overseas. We have even decided applications and the time it will be used with some companies, and we are set to see the application of CXP materials in numerous large companies in 1~2 years.”

They then went on to say, “We are seeking to introduce a new flame-retardant grade CXP product at CES, and have deep conversations with the actual industry on how it can be utilized at CES, which is closely related to electricity and electronics. We will also actively raise awareness of flame-retardant woods.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
